lines.speaker: Ash Witness
lines.text: You are late. I watched you leave this path already.

lines.speaker: Ash Witness
lines.text: The ash remembers a body even when the body returns.

lines.speaker: Ash Witness
lines.text: The path is young. It has not learned your weight yet.

lines.speaker: Ash Witness
lines.text: Past the roots, something is keeping the fire alive.
